mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies with a temperature of 77 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School and an air quality index of 52.
City residents should know that engineering updates continue through AECOM, and the Senior Center is currently offering free tri-shaw bike rides along the Military Ridge State Trail.

There is a busy schedule today including live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Tomorrow, you can drop into a yoga session at Insight Wellness.
Regarding local safety, on July 31, police stopped a vehicle for an equipment violation which resulted in the driver being arrested for an O W I.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
